title: NASA Cameras on Blue Ghost Capture First-of-its-Kind Moon Landing Footage
description: This compressed, resolution-limited video features a preliminary sequence of the Blue Ghost final descent and landing that NASA researchers stitched together from SCALPSS 1.1’s four short-focal-length cameras, which were capturing photos at 8 frames per second. Altitude data is approximate.
keywords: Stereo Cameras for Lunar-Plume Surface Studies, SCALPSS, SCALPSS 1.1, Mare Crisium, Moon, Lunar, Surface, Artemis, Commercial Lunar Payload Services, CLPS
